title: Finite-cover augmentation on every K-injective complex
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $r\geq0$, and $U:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to X_{\mathrm{open}}$ a family with $\bigcup_i U_i=X$. Let $J$ be an arbitrary unbounded K-injective complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. The actual natural cochain augmentation $\alpha_J:\Gamma(X,J)\to T_U(J)$ defined in [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex], using module-valued global sections [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology], is a quasi-isomorphism. Neither affine intersections, quasi-coherence, nor injectivity of individual terms of $J$ is assumed.

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma 08C1, proof using 01EP and alternating comparison; parent proof Steps 4--5

proof.text: Use the already proved functorial degreewise-injective K-injective resolution j:J to I on the module category. Its quasi-isomorphism instance and the K-injective quasiIso_iff theorem give a HomotopyEquiv e whose forward map is j.

Global sections is additive and sends e to a homotopy equivalence. For Cech totalization use the homotopy-preservation theorem on the two inverse homotopies of e, use map_comp and map_id, and form the total homotopy equivalence explicitly. Both forward maps are quasi-isomorphisms.

Apply the injective-term augmentation theorem to I, with termwise injectivity supplied by the resolution instance. Naturality identifies alpha_J followed by T(j) with S(j) followed by alpha_I. The latter composite is a quasi-isomorphism; quasiIso_iff_comp_right cancels the quasi-isomorphism T(j). This proves the unchanged assertion for J.

proof_origin.place: Tag 08C1; T2 Lean proof using degreewise-injective resolution, explicitly proved total homotopy preservation, augmentation naturality and two-out-of-three
